issues.title: Broken External Spec References (AC-24)
issues.why: AC-24 explicitly references AC-SD-22 (spec/05) and AC-T-28 (spec/27) which are not provided in the current context, creating a dependency gap for a standalone coder.
issues.fix: Incorporate the specific requirements of AC-SD-22 and AC-T-28 directly into AC-22 or provide the text of those external ACs in a 'Dependencies' section.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Positive Condition' Rule
issues.why: The rule 'Always positive — no !, no !=' in 08-code-style.md is logically impossible for error checking (e.g., 'if err != nil') which is standard in Go.
issues.fix: Clarify that the 'positive condition' rule applies to domain logic and boolean flags, explicitly exempting standard error handling patterns.

issues.title: Missing 'doctor' Command Example
issues.why: AC-20 defines complex behavior for a 'doctor' command (interactive prompts, shell injection), but no code snippet or sample output is provided in the prose files.
issues.fix: Add a '21-post-install-shell-activation.md' file (referenced but not provided) or include a sample 'runDoctor' handler snippet in 03-subcommand-architecture.md.
